description: This file defines the MainFragment class, a fragment in an Android application responsible for managing the main notes UI. It handles user interactions such as creating notes, searching, attaching files, recording audio, navigating to note editors, and updating UI components like toolbars and menus.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that manages the main notes interface, facilitating note creation, editing, searching, sorting, and UI configurations.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, user interactions, and listeners after the view is created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the options menu in the toolbar.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items such as search, layout toggle, sorting options, and other actions.

methods.name: actionToEditor
methods.description: Generates navigation directions to the editor screen, with optional note ID, attachments, and transition options.

methods.name: actionToSearch
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the search screen with an optional query.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles the event when a note is clicked, navigating to the editor with the selected note ID.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long-clicks on notes, typically showing a context menu.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on the current selection of notes.

methods.name: onLayoutModeChanged
methods.description: Updates UI elements when the layout mode (grid/list) changes.

methods.name: onSortMethodChanged
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current sorting method.

methods.name: goToEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the note editor, passing relevant IDs, attachments, and shared element info.

methods.name: setupFab
methods.description: Configures the floating action button for creating new notes.

methods.name: setLayoutChangeActionIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for layout toggle based on current mode.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Highlights the currently selected sort method in the menu.

methods.name: setupBottomAppBar
methods.description: Configures the bottom app bar menu actions including creating lists, recording audio, attaching files, and taking photos.
